text:
maria_sales: Heads up — Acquarius POC is escalating. CISO flagged BYO KMS requirement + egress pricing sensitivity + a 99th%-tile latency ask. Exec requested a call Fri 11am PT. Need clear owners for KMS addendum, throughput plan, and any pricing concession. @sam_se can you confirm the technical approach? @julia_legal can you start an addendum draft? :eyes:

sam_se: On it. SE can run the BYO KMS flow. Quick clarifying question: do they require HSM-backed keys or just importable keys? Also: what's their expected sustained qps?

nate_enginfra: We support BYO via standard KMS import/bring-your-key flow. Operational note: we need an explicit SLA for key usage pattern and a brief runbook for ops. If they want low-latency key ops, we should plan to cache key metadata and signatures.

maria_sales: They gave ranges: 50 qps sustained, spikes to ~200 qps. Very cautious about token egress costs. They're also asking for a 20% pilot discount.

ara_pm: For 50–200 qps, recommend Dedicated pool (reserved GPUs) with burst capacity. Also propose model quantization + KV caching to lower unit cost. I'll draft recommended config.

sam_se: I'll prepare a short architecture slide for the exec call: BYO KMS flow, fallback if BYO fails, and autoscale config. Need someone to confirm latency SLOs we can promise in writing.

leo_ciso: Security perspective: BYO KMS acceptable if customer agrees to a limited key-access audit and attestation. We need key lifecycle controls (rotation policy, destruction proof) and proof of SOC2 + crypto attestation. Also, they require data residency in eu-west-1 for the PoC.

julia_legal: I'll start an addendum template for BYO KMS (key responsibilities, indemnities, audit access). For the pricing concession we need written approval from Sales leadership and finance. Who will own that ask?

maria_sales: I own the negotiation but will need legal + finance signoff. I'll tag leadership once we have an option.

sam_se: For fallback, we can offer tenant-managed keys (Redwood-managed key per tenant) with encryption at rest if BYO isn't available immediately. I'll include perf numbers for both paths.

nate_enginfra: FYI: BYO KMS naive path can add ~20–40ms per cold-start key op; with caching we're at <5% latency delta in steady-state. I'll include measurements in INF-9234.

deploy-bot: Ticket INF-9234 created for BYO KMS enablement (assignee: nate_enginfra). SLA review task assigned to julia_legal.

ara_pm: Recommend a 1-week canary Dedicated environment to validate throughput and security posture. Suggest offering a 10% pilot credit instead of full 20% until we validate metrics.

maria_sales: Can finance approve 10%? @finance-team — I'll ping them separately.

julia_legal: I can approve the addendum template draft. Pricing concession needs documented approval from Sales leadership; cc @vp_sales when ready.

sam_se: I will have the tech deck ready by tomorrow EOD. Maria, please confirm the exec call slot and I'll block it.

maria_sales: Confirmed — Fri 11am PT. I'll send the invite and attach the security questionnaire answers we already completed.

leo_ciso: I'll compile the KMS attestation checklist tonight and post it here.

nate_enginfra: INF-9234: I'll post the initial runbook + perf numbers in this thread when ready.

maria_sales: Thanks all — marking this thread "exec-escalation". Please flag any blockers before EOD Thu. :thumbsup:
